facts.fact: ANDE, created by decree of 12 April 2022, is charged with building and managing state-wide systems (state intranet, unified communication tools, integrated financial and administrative system, e-archiving) and coordinating public data centres for central, local and public bodies; the page states the mandate, dated by the founding decree.
facts.system: ANDE (Agence Nationale de Digitalisation de l'Etat)

systems.system: Integrated financial and administrative management system
